pages.title: Clydesdale
pages.text: Scotland's draft giant, easy to spot by its white-feathered legs and bold **field** markings.

pages.title: Coat
pages.text:
Always with **Field** markings:

- Brown + White Field
- Black + White Field
- Dark Brown + White Field
- Chestnut + White Field

pages.title: Where They Live
pages.text:
Rough hill country:

- Windswept Hills
- Windswept Gravelly Hills
- Windswept Forest
- Old Growth Pine Taiga
